description: Choose your kernel subsystems and the exact apps bundled with TRUEOS.
semantics: Each bundled app is an independent payload choice; selecting none gives Kernel only. USB, Intel iGPU, and Virgl switches control device initialization. Shared interfaces and driver code remain compiled; complete driver binary pruning is not implemented.

features.label: Bundled apps (buildins)
features.description: Compatibility shorthand for all or no bundled apps. The individual app checklist chooses an exact set; selected kernel capabilities remain available.

features.label: USB
features.description: Claim xHCI controllers and enable USB input, storage, MIDI, and network devices.

features.label: Intel iGPU
features.description: Initialize supported Intel display, render, media, and compute hardware.

features.label: Virgl / virtio GPU
features.description: Initialize the QEMU virtio GPU and its Virgl compositor when available.

features.label: H.264 streaming
features.description: Build the Intel hardware video streaming service.

features.label: Native GPGPU development
features.description: Enable runtime-generated native compute for odin.son development.

features.label: Task profiling
features.description: Build executor task profiling and diagnostics.

features.label: Experimental speech
features.description: Build the optional CPU speech and Kokoro services; runtime model assets are still required.

buildins.label: Appstore
buildins.description: Browse, download, verify, and launch applications. Omit it when you supply apps another way.

buildins.label: Commander
buildins.description: Terminal-to-VLayer control with keyboard and mouse input.

buildins.label: Hull
buildins.description: The default desktop application. Omitting it also skips its default startup.

buildins.label: Trauma
buildins.description: HTTP and HTTPS downloads with retry support.

buildins.label: SSH
buildins.description: Connect to remote hosts with the SSH client.

buildins.label: Image viewer
buildins.description: View PNG and JPEG images with gallery browsing, pan, and zoom.

buildins.label: OS
buildins.description: System installation, live updates, reboot, and shutdown controls.

buildins.label: Termdir
buildins.description: Browse and manage files through the directory explorer.

buildins.label: Edit
buildins.description: Read and edit text with the terminal editor.

buildins.label: Share
buildins.description: Serve application files through the standalone WebDAV app.

buildins.label: Paper
buildins.description: An editable sheet with gridpaper, linepaper, and whitepaper modes.

presets.label: Universal
presets.description: Preserve the current default build: USB, supported Intel graphics, and the QEMU fallback.

presets.label: Intel desktop
presets.description: Supported Intel graphics with USB input, media streaming, and native compute.

presets.label: QEMU / Virgl
presets.description: USB and the virtio GPU compositor, with Intel device initialization disabled.

presets.label: Kernel only
presets.description: No bundled apps, including the file explorer, app store, and text editor. Keep the normal kernel capabilities and choose your own subsystem switches.

reference.label: TRUEOS 0.0.235
reference.profile_basis: user-described release; no build sidecar in archive
reference.note: Measured release reference. The archive does not prove its source revisions; rebuilt sizes may differ.

kernel.label: Kernel + assets baseline
kernel.note: Release kernel ELF minus its embedded compressed AppDB; includes other assets and layout overhead. Not a measured kernel-only build.

subsystems.note: Subsystem reductions are not measured. USB, Intel iGPU, and Virgl switches currently control initialization; no byte savings are deducted.

units.label: kB
units.rounding: Sum exact byte counts before rounding to the nearest whole kB.

size_estimates.note: Selected-app and omitted-app totals use packed BP bytes. Kernel plus apps is an additive estimate, not a final ELF, compressed download, or RAM measurement.
